title: Amber Context Grant (v1)
description: F069 (Harness v2 §11): Grant = Subject × Resource × Purpose × Time × Policy. The admitted, immutable authorization for one subject to read resource prefixes for one purpose inside a half-open TTL window, under a classification ceiling from the loadout vocabulary (public < internal < confidential < restricted < secret; 'unknown' is unrated and fails closed). The grant authorizes READING labels and the covered resources — it never carries values, and the report-first check never gates the existing context lifecycle (H3b wires that).

subject.description: The granted principal (agent id, human id, or role label) — one subject per grant.

items.description: A repo-relative posix resource prefix (same shape rules as execution contracts).

purpose.description: The bound purpose (exact-match at check time).

classificationCeiling.description: The highest classification this grant covers. 'unknown' resources are unrated and deny fail-closed.

validUntil.description: Half-open window [validFrom, validUntil) with no clock-skew tolerance; expiry is a read-time projection, never an edit.

policy.description: Reference to the governing policy pin.
